name: mtm-contract
description: MTM Contract — a contract-first discipline for delegating implementation to AI agents. Put the cheap checks before the expensive generation.

plugins.name: mtm
plugins.description: Classify a task by observable triggers, ground your assumptions before generating code, enumerate what an ambiguous request could mean instead of guessing, never mark a check passed on a promise, and get a clean-context review before merging risky work. Ships a zero-dependency validator that enforces the mechanical half.
